column1: # California's benchmark Marketplace premium for a 40-year-old went from $321 a month in 2017 to $548 in 2026.

# Source: Urban Institute, American Affordability Tracker (ODC-BY 1.0): unsubsidized second-lowest-cost Silver premium for a 40-year-old, averaged by population. Most Covered California members pay much less after subsidies. Not adjusted for inflation.
